title: Empowerment for Service
definition: Empowerment for service is the Holy Spirit's enabling of believers to serve Christ and others with faithfulness, humility, love, and spiritual strength.
summary: The Spirit empowers ordinary believers for faithful service.
christFocus: Jesus gives the Spirit so His people may serve His body and mission with His strength.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Christian service is not meant to be carried out merely in human strength. The Spirit empowers believers to serve with gifts, wisdom, love, courage, and endurance.

This empowerment is not for self-display. It is for building up the Church, loving neighbors, proclaiming the Gospel, and glorifying Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many believers feel too weak or ordinary to serve. This doctrine matters because God equips His people for the work He gives.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Serve with dependence rather than self-reliance. Ask the Spirit for strength, humility, and love as you use what God has entrusted to you.

relatedTopics: Spiritual Gifts and Ministry of the Holy Spirit
